The coat and the ankle boots keep the walk to the office looking tidy, and the bag finishes it. Inside, the suit does the work. It sits a little more casual than a strict office, so wearing the jacket and trousers together is what brings it up to a neat working look.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Wear the suit jacket and trousers together, with the longsleeve top under the jacket, so the outfit reads as a neat office look.\",\"Wear the scarf at your neck under the coat and raise the coat's collar for the frost. It adds a clean vertical near your face.\",\"Put the beanie on for the walk through the snow.\"],\"wrong_photos\":[],\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#106·29\",\"what\":\"suit jacket and trousers\"},{\"n\":\"#68·18\",\"what\":\"longsleeve top\"},{\"n\":\"#211·04\",\"what\":\"coat\"},{\"n\":\"#540·05\",\"what\":\"ankle boots\"},{\"n\":\"#498·07\",\"what\":\"bag\"},{\"n\":\"#494·30\",\"what\":\"beanie\"},{\"n\":\"#420·30\",\"what\":\"scarf\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#106·29\",\"text\":\"I chose this suit on purpose as the base of your office day. Worn as a full set, it gives the outfit its working structure.\"},{\"n\":\"#68·18\",\"text\":\"This longsleeve top suits an office day, and its fabric holds up in deep frost, so it is a sensible layer under the jacket.\"},{\"n\":\"#211·04\",\"text\":\"The coat is wool, which ranks high for deep frost, and its level fits a working day, so it covers the snowy walk and still looks right at the office.\"},{\"n\":\"#540·05\",\"text\":\"The ankle boots sit at the right level for your workday and finish the outfit on your feet.\"},{\"n\":\"#498·07\",\"text\":\"I chose this bag on purpose to complete the outfit for your office day.\"},{\"n\":\"#494·30\",\"text\":\"The beanie's fabric suits deep frost, so it keeps your head warm on the walk to work.\"},{\"n\":\"#420·30\",\"text\":\"The scarf's fabric suits deep frost, so it adds warmth at the neck where the cold bites on a long walk.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":26197,"output_tokens":2352},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
